system.description:
When shot at a water craft of any sort, a missile with this talent inflicts [[/r 1d10 +10 #Hull damage]] (11-20) hull points of damage when it hits. (The armor class of the vessel is used, as if the shot were a ramming or catapult attack.)

Important: These missiles do not become nonmagical once used.

Fletched arrows in a quiver. Can be used with a long bow or short bow. These arrows are magical and provide a to-hit and damage bonus.
